1.title: The Crypto Industry Targets Sherrod Brown of Ohio, a Top Democratic Senate Candidate
1.summary: Angry after the defeat of a major crypto bill last week, the industry is planning to spend $30 million against Sherrod Brown in Ohio.

2.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico to file lawsuit against Trump's White House ban
2.summary: Major US networks later suspended White House TV coverage of Trump as he heads to New York for the UN summit.

3.title: JB Pritzker Says He Used GLP-1s to Lose 80 Pounds
3.summary: Gov. JB Pritzker of Illinois, widely seen as a potential presidential candidate, revealed in an interview on “CBS Mornings” that he had been on a GLP-1 regimen since 2024.

4.title: Airlines criticise air traffic control as second glitch causes more disruption in UK
4.summary: EasyJet says the latest incident "once again calls into question the resilience" of the system.

5.title: At 92, the Bard of Bollywood Is Still Writing About Love
5.summary: The poet and lyricist Gulzar has profoundly shaped the idea of tender romance in India through his verse and songs in more than 150 musicals.

6.title: One Issue That Could Upend Fragile U.S.-China Ties: Taiwan Arms
6.summary: As Beijing presses President Trump to freeze a proposed $14 billion weapons sale to the island, Taiwan is trying to show that its security is in U.S. interests.
